purpose: Bilingual account-access Help landing, factual self-service guidance, safe account-support handoff and honest unavailable/stale states.
content_owner: Content & Media (version/copy); Identity & Access owns verification, sign-in, recovery and security actions
copy_risk: Class A + B; security-critical explanatory copy receives owner/content/language/security review before use
review_scope: 25 new semantic keys, 50 EN/AF strings; 7 existing keys referenced unchanged
source_authority: Prior owner-approved FP-001 Account Settings, MFA and verification-result evidence

included: Help landing and account-access topic navigation
factual conditional sign-in, verification and password-reset guidance
optional MFA, loss of factors and suspicious access guidance
safe contact-support entry, secret-sharing warning and support-authority boundary
loading, unavailable and stale presentation copy
excluded: new public support form, support ticket/case or response SLA
support case states, staff handling or backend permission changes
manual recovery method or zero-factor proof selection (WELL-115)
new account or security actions, step-up bypass or admin override
implementation, public release or paid-pilot authorisation

transitions: loading -> ready only after available Help routes are read
loading -> unavailable on failed required read
ready -> stale when route eligibility or account authority changes
stale -> ready only after a fresh authorised read
ready -> route_opened only for currently available route
guards: Help can be publicly readable where product permits; do not require sign-in to view general guidance
links/actions appear only for currently available, authorised destinations
Identity must independently recheck real sign-in, recovery, proof and step-up requests
no page open or support contact changes account state
do not disclose account existence or inaccessible security detail
presentation_lifecycle.side_effects: Viewing Help has none; route_opened means navigation only, never successful authentication/recovery/support receipt
presentation_lifecycle.terminal: route_opened ends the navigation interaction, not the underlying Identity/Support journey
presentation_lifecycle.retries_recovery: Read-only refresh is safe and repeatable; ambiguous route/current-access state shows unavailable or stale and fails closed
presentation_lifecycle.durable_support_lifecycle: Not defined here; an actual support case/form requires its owning authority and separately reviewed contract

en.text: Help with your account

af.text: Hulp met jou rekening

en.text: Find guidance for signing in, verifying your email address and keeping access to your account.

af.text: Kry hulp met aanmelding, e-posverifikasie en toegang tot jou rekening.

en.text: What do you need help with?

af.text: Waarmee het jy hulp nodig?

en.text: Signing in

af.text: Aanmelding

en.text: If you cannot sign in, check the email address and password you entered. You can use an available password-reset option if needed.

af.text: As jy nie kan aanmeld nie, gaan die e-posadres en wagwoord na wat jy ingevul het. Jy kan ook ’n beskikbare wagwoordherstelopsie gebruik.

en.text: Open sign-in page

af.text: Maak die aanmeldbladsy oop

en.text: Verify your email address

af.text: Verifieer jou e-posadres

en.text: If you have a verification email, open its link and choose "Verify email". Opening the page alone does not verify your address.

af.text: As jy ’n verifikasie-e-pos het, maak die skakel daarin oop en kies "Verifieer e-posadres". Om net die bladsy oop te maak, verifieer nie jou adres nie.

en.text: Didn't receive a verification email?

af.text: Het jy nie ’n verifikasie-e-pos ontvang nie?

en.text: Check your inbox and junk folder. If a resend option is available, request another verification email.

af.text: Gaan jou e-posse na (kyk ook in jou Spam). As daar ’n opsie is om weer te stuur, vra nog ’n verifikasie-e-pos aan.

emphasis.markdown_review_only: Gaan jou e-posse na (kyk ook in jou *Spam*). As daar ’n opsie is om weer te stuur, vra nog ’n verifikasie-e-pos aan.
emphasis.rendering_requirement: Italicise only Spam. A future UI must render this as semantic emphasis, not display raw Markdown markers. Never use HTML injection.

en.text: Reset your password

af.text: Herstel jou wagwoord

en.text: If you've forgotten your password, use the password-reset option on the sign-in page. Requesting a reset does not change your password.

af.text: As jy jou wagwoord vergeet het, gebruik die wagwoordherstelopsie op die aanmeldbladsy. Om wagwoordherstel aan te vra, verander nie jou wagwoord nie.

en.text: Open password reset

af.text: Maak wagwoordherstel oop

en.text: If you cannot use your verification app, use an available recovery option or contact support. This Help page cannot bypass a required security check.

af.text: As jy nie jou verifikasie-app kan gebruik nie, gebruik ’n beskikbare herstelopsie of kontak ondersteuning. Hierdie Hulp-bladsy kan nie ’n verpligte sekuriteitskontrole omseil nie.

en.text: Lost access to all your verification methods?

af.text: Het jy toegang tot al jou verifikasiemetodes verloor?

en.text: Contact support to find out which recovery steps are available. Contacting support does not by itself restore account access.

af.text: Kontak ondersteuning om uit te vind watter herstelstappe beskikbaar is. Deur ondersteuning te kontak, kry jy nie vanself weer toegang tot jou rekening nie.

en.text: Concerned about account security?

af.text: Bekommerd oor jou rekening se sekuriteit?

en.text: If you think someone else accessed your account, use any available security options and contact support. Account changes may require another identity check.

af.text: As jy vermoed dat iemand anders toegang tot jou rekening gehad het, gebruik enige beskikbare sekuriteitsopsies en kontak ondersteuning. Jy sal dalk weer jou identiteit moet bevestig voordat rekeningveranderinge aangebring kan word.

en.text: Ask for account help

af.text: Vra hulp met jou rekening

en.text: Use an available support channel if the account-help options do not solve your problem.

af.text: Gebruik ’n beskikbare ondersteuningskanaal as die opsies vir rekeninghulp nie jou probleem oplos nie.

en.text: Never share your password, verification codes, sign-in or recovery links, or your verification app's secret key with support.

af.text: Moet nooit jou wagwoord, verifikasiekodes, aanmeld- of herstelskakels of die geheime sleutel van jou verifikasie-app met ondersteuning deel nie.

en.text: Contacting support does not verify your identity or authorise account changes.

af.text: Kontak met ondersteuning bevestig nie jou identiteit nie en magtig nie rekeningveranderinge nie.

en.text: Loading account help…

af.text: Besig om rekeninghulp te laai…

en.text: Account help is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or use another available help option.

af.text: Rekeninghulp is tydelik nie beskikbaar nie. Probeer later weer of gebruik ’n ander beskikbare hulpopsie.

en.text: Available help options have changed. Refresh to see what's available now.

af.text: Die beskikbare hulpopsies het verander. Herlaai die bladsy om te sien wat nou beskikbaar is.

approval.decision: Approved and authorized to open a PR. Owner requests revised Afrikaans missing-verification-email help text and italics on the word Spam.
approval.scope: Exact NewYou platform account-access Help copy; one Afrikaans string changed, typography metadata binds the word Spam only

review_boundary.scope: Content-evidence and delivery-router record only; source registry statuses not changed
review_boundary.presentation_lifecycle: Preserve source candidate navigation/read-only lifecycle; no new SupportCase or ticket lifecycle invented
review_boundary.owner_domains: Content & Media owns copy; Identity & Access owns credentials/proof/recovery; Support access retains governed scope
review_boundary.security: Help-page retrieval and contact are non-mutating and never establish verification, login, support approval or account recovery
review_boundary.locale: Both English and Afrikaans required; no silent fallback
review_boundary.markup: The italic Spam span is exact evidence of the approved formatting requirement; rendering is future JIT and must not be inferred from Markdown delimiters
